name: steps
title: Steps
description: Steps with progress for a setup or a checkout: the line draws on to the current step on a spring, the current step lights up, and a finished step fills and gets a check that draws itself. A list with aria-current="step" and a progressbar with the number of steps done; nothing takes focus.
author: ARLing s. r. o. (https://arling.sk)
docs:
Steps from ARLing Motion (MIT).
React: import { Steps } from "@/components/ui/motion-steps".
The logic is in lib/arling-motion-steps.js (typed by the .d.ts next to it) and works without React: createSteps on your own markup.
Styles were added to your global CSS under @layer components (Tailwind v4).
With Tailwind v3 or no Tailwind, add https://arling.sk/motion/components/steps/steps.css to your styles instead.
Live demo and docs: https://arling.sk/motion/#steps
